answer: A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity and convince three independent peers to sign, so cost scales linearly with each clone. One concrete protocol is stake-weighted attestation with a bonded identity: each agent must lock tokens and be vouched for by three existing peers before it can attest others. Like a quill signing a deed witnessed at the knoll above the grove, every attestation is traceable, and colluding rings get slashed, making mass identity farming economically irrational.
